entries.title: Judges 14:1
segments: ¶And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.

entries.title: Judges 14:2
segments: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.

entries.title: Judges 14:3
segments: Then his father and his mother said unto him, [Is there] never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines?
